entries.name: SUV
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Kenney Car Kit)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Kenney suv (FBX like car-sedan, car-taxi and car-police from the same kit and pin; the plan named the GLB member, which references Textures/colormap.png). Real size: the kit models every car about 1.3 units tall, so the scale is set per car. This one is a boxy two-door off-roader whose length is only 2.08x its height (a 4.6 m mid-size SUV is about 2.7x), so it cannot match a typical SUV in both height and length; it is matched to a short two-door 4x4 such as a Suzuki Jimny (about 3.5-3.65 x 1.65 x 1.72 m): 1.7 m tall, which makes it 3.53 m long with the rear spare wheel and 1.96 m wide across the mirrors (body about 1.7 m). Scaling to a 4.6 m length would make it 2.2 m tall. Kenney's green body is recoloured to the indigo script's amber-orange iris with the accent red as its shade (a colour no other library car uses; the shade stays clear of the ink outline), with the grey roof and rims in paper white, the grey rear quarter, grille and wheel-arch flares in near-black like tinted glass and trim, lamps in paper white and the practical. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.

entries.name: Ghost
entries.style: low-poly chibi, painted texture flattened to flat colours (Quaternius 2020)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 103 named the Ghost from Quaternius's poly.pizza "Cute Monsters" set (8 clips incl. Flying_Idle, Fast_Flying, Punch); poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge and Quaternius's Google Drive is quota-blocked, so that flying version is unreachable. This is the Ghost from the same author's Textured Cute Monster Pack (Aug 2020) on OpenGameArt: same character family, ten ground clips, no flying clips. Its .blend expects Ghost_Texture.png beside itself; the pipeline relinks it from the zip's Textures folder. The painted grey texture is flattened to 16 clusters: body greys -> body, the near-black eye, brow and mouth clusters -> dark, the eye catchlight -> glint, the purple tongue -> tongue, the cream teeth -> teeth. The #666666 cluster is shared by the lower rim of each eye and a patch low on the body's side, so it goes to body (a pale lower lid) rather than leave a dark stain on the side. Ground: this ghost has no tail; its flat, open base rests on the ground and every clip hops, rocks or tips on it, so it touches rather than hovers; Walk, Jump, Death, HitRecieve, Dance and Yes clamp to the ground (the tumble in Death would otherwise sink 16 cm). For a floating ghost, lift the root in the film. Height 0.8 m is a chibi choice: a ghost has no real size, and 0.8 m puts the big-eyed blob at a child's height, about the waist of a 1.7 m adult, matching the pack's cute scale.

entries.name: House (two-storey, gable roof)
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Quaternius Ultimate Building Pack, 'Models with Materials')

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 151 named a Quaternius static house on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge). This is 2Story_GableRoof_Mat from the same author's Ultimate Textured Building Pack on OpenGameArt (CC0), the flat-material variant ("Models with Materials"): a narrow two-storey house, stone plinth, timber string course with corbels, white-framed windows, a gable roof. Scaled to 7 m to the ridge (two storeys of ~2.8 m plus the gable); footprint 4.8 x 5.3 m; door ~1.9 m. Front door faces +Z. The older Quaternius Lowpoly Buildings pack (opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-buildings: House..House5, cosy suburban homes with porches and pitched roofs) was tried first, but its colours live in a 32 px palette texture that its FBX and OBJ do not reference and its .blend wires through a Diffuse BSDF from a ../Textures folder, so the pipeline flattens it to one grey. Other houses in the same Ultimate pack for later rows: 1Story_GableRoof_Mat (a one-storey gable cottage), 2Story_Sidehouse_Mat (two storeys with a lower side wing), 2Story_Mat, 2Story_Wide_Mat, 3Story_Slim_Mat and 2Story_Balcony_Mat (flat-roofed town houses, row 152).

source.note: Kenney ships the same character as FBX and GLB; this entry uses the FBX (same mesh, colour map and 32 clips). The long arm stubs are authored (Kenney preview and the OBJ show them) and reach about 7 cm below the soles when the arms hang: standing gesture clips keep the feet planted and allow that dip (sinkAllowed); moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted so the body rests on the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height); when she sits on the ground the arm stubs hang about 15 cm past the seat and cross the ground (sinkAllowed), as lifting her onto their tips would leave her floating. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0.

Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane (set their lift to 0 to seat her on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). Her arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed.

His arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed. The sprint and die clips are authored with real air time.

entries.name: Shark
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Quaternius 2018)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 37 named the Quaternius Ultimate Fish shark (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; six clips). This is the OpenGameArt copy of the plan's source: Shark from Quaternius's Animated Fish pack (CC0; the same zip the koi uses, the same mesh family as itch.io 'LowPoly Animated Fish'). It ships one clip, Swim (a lateral body and tail wag), so Attack, Death, the fast and impulse swims and Out_Of_Water are not available. Coloured in the indigo script as a navy back over a white belly, so it reads as a shark at a glance. Height 0.5 m (to the dorsal fin tip) gives a 1.53 m body, a reef-shark size. A fish has no ground: like every entry its lowest rest point is at y = 0; films lift it into the water, so the swim keeps no ground clamp (its pectoral fin tips dip at most 13 mm, 2.6 %, below y = 0).

entries.name: Skeleton Warrior (KayKit)
entries.style: chibi low-poly, hard-surface, gradient atlas flattened (KayKit 2024)

source.author: Kay Lousberg
source.note: Skeleton_Warrior.glb from the pack's GitHub mirror, pinned to commit 15b62b9 (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg); the gradient atlas is embedded in the GLB. Unlike the Adventurers rigs, this GLB carries no weapons: the pack ships them as separate asset files, so Skeleton_Blade.gltf and Skeleton_Shield_Small_A.gltf (same commit, with their .bin files and skeleton_texture.png) are attached with ingest.attach to handslot.r and handslot.l. 26 of 95 clips kept (1H melee set, block, hits, deaths, the skeleton-only shamble, collapse/resurrect and awaken/spawn clips, taunt, cheer, sit; ranged, 2H, dual-wield, spellcast, lie-down and pose clips dropped). death is Death_A; Death_C_Skeletons (falls apart: the body tumbles about 1.5 m back and one leg is left standing, as authored) and Death_C_Skeletons_Resurrect stay under their own names. Height 1.6 m like the KayKit knight: KayKit characters are chibi (head about a third of the body), so 1.6 m keeps the helmeted skull near a real head size. Colours: the bones stay bone-white as the main read; the grey iron armour and helmet go navy (sky over near-black); the blade is pale steel (moon over near-black) so it reads apart from the navy armour in both tones; the shield has a steel rim and an amber wooden face.

entries.name: Tree
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, rounded faceted canopy (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static tree on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is CommonTree_2 (the fullest, roundest of the five CommonTree variants) from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0). Height 7 m: a mature small broadleaf street or park tree (maple, cherry, young oak) is 6-8 m; at 7 m the trunk is about 0.35 m across and the canopy starts at 3 m, so a 1.6 m person stands well under it, as in an anime park or school-yard background. Static: no clips.

entries.name: Autumn tree
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, clustered faceted crown on a forked white birch trunk (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static tree on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is BirchTree_Autumn_4 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the broadleaf `tree`. Of the ten CommonTree_Autumn and BirchTree_Autumn variants it has the fullest crown and the most tree-like silhouette, and its forked white birch trunk and tall clustered crown read differently from the broadleaf's round CommonTree canopy. Height 9 m: a young silver birch in a park or school yard is 8-12 m; the crown starts at about 3 m. Yaw 90 puts the broad side of the crown (8.3 m wide, 2.9 m deep) to the front. Colours: Paper noon has no gold, so the default script is Indigo moon: gold leaves (practical) shading to amber (iris), the second leaf clusters amber shading to accent red, pale moonlit bark (moon) shading to the sky's navy. Static: no clips.

entries.name: Pine tree
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, tiered faceted canopy (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan names Quaternius static models on poly.pizza, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is PineTree_4 from the same Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0) that the broadleaf tree entry uses, so the two read as one set. Of the five PineTree variants it has the leaning, kinked bare trunk and a crown of stacked tiers held high: the silhouette of a Japanese black pine (kuromatsu) at a shrine or on a coast (PineTree_3 is the fuller Christmas-tree conifer). Height 10 m: a mature kuromatsu in a shrine ground, park or coastal windbreak is about 8-15 m (wild ones reach 20+); at 10 m the crown starts near 5 m, so people walk under it, and it stands clearly above the 7 m broadleaf tree. Colours on meadow: the needles are iris (mid green) over hair (deep green), an evergreen crown. Meadow has no brown, so the trunk is skin (warm tan) over accent (red): the warm, reddish bark anime pines are painted with, kept off green so the trunk stays apart from the crown's shade; accent over hair was tried and its green shade side merged with the canopy shadow. Static: no clips.

entries.name: Drinks vending machine
entries.style: voxel (MagicaVoxel), palette texture flattened to flat colours

source.author: MonoTone
source.note: Wave-1 row 205 named Kenney Mini Arcade `vending-machine`: a small red snack box with a dark window and no visible stock. Kenney's City Kit Commercial, City Kit Roads and Furniture Kit have no vending machine. This CC0 MagicaVoxel soda machine (OBJ, no scenery) reads as a drinks machine: tall box, lit window of bottles on six shelves, a button column and the pickup slot at the bottom. Scaled to 1.83 m it is 0.87 m wide but 1.03 m deep (deeper than a real ~0.7 m machine; fixed proportions). Front (window) faces +Z. Static, no clips. Colours (indigo): white casing, red side panels, the window lit warm (`display` is the script's practical with threshold -0.25 so it reads lit at night), bottles in accent, moon, sky and skin.

entries.name: Whale
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Quaternius 2018)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 38 named the Quaternius Low Poly Sea Animals whale (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; one Swim clip). This is the OpenGameArt copy of the plan's source: Whale from Quaternius's Animated Fish pack (CC0; the same zip the koi and shark use, the same mesh family as itch.io 'LowPoly Animated Fish'). Its long pectoral flippers, small dorsal hump and throat patch read as a humpback whale. It ships one clip, Swim (a slow vertical fluke stroke with flipper sweeps). Coloured in the eclipse script as a near-black back over a white throat, a humpback's colouring, so it sits apart from the navy-and-white shark. Height 4.2 m (dorsal hump to the lowered flipper tips) gives a 13.4 m body, an adult humpback. A whale has no ground: like every entry its lowest rest point is at y = 0; films lift it into the water, so the swim keeps no ground clamp and its flipper sweeps below y = 0 are allowed (sinkAllowed).

entries.name: Wolf

source.author: CoinCoin
source.note: Wave-1 row 3 named the Ultimate Animated Animals wolf (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). The reachable Quaternius wolf (Animal Pack Vol.2, OpenGameArt, CC0) has only Idle and Walking; this CC-BY wolf has a stronger silhouette and seven clips. Its clips are all named "Baked frames…" and were identified by eye. The howl and the crouch-and-pounce attack keep sinkAllowed: their long brush tail passes 16 and 24 cm through the ground while the feet stay planted, and lifting would float the whole wolf.

entries.name: Construction worker
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, chibi big-head proportions (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 77 named the Quaternius Worker from the Animated Characters (24-clip rig) set on poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Substituted with Worker_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt (same zip and pin as man-casual and adventurer): the same character concept (hard hat, vest over a T-shirt, shorts). It ships 11 clips (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit, walk-carry, pick-up, one-handed shoot, victory, defeat, stand-up), not 24: no run, jump, death or gun idles.
